demo.name: 11 · League standings
demo.description: A designed league table: the panel unfolds, the header wipes in, the ten rows fly in one after the other, the points count up and the form dots pop in; the rows leave in reverse order. A highlight bar moves to the position you choose (logic: (position − 1) × row height + top).
